title: Joplin Notes Sync Settings
description: Non-secret connection settings. Set your Joplin API token from the plugin's own page (Menu → Joplin Notes Sync) — it is stored as a local secret, never here.

joplinUrl.title: Joplin Web Clipper URL
joplinUrl.description: Base URL of Joplin's local Web Clipper API. Enable it in Joplin under Options → Web Clipper.

parentNotebookTitle.title: Parent notebook
parentNotebookTitle.description: Notebook created in Joplin to hold one sub-notebook per Super Productivity project.

syncIntervalSec.title: Auto-sync interval (seconds)
syncIntervalSec.description: How often to check for changed notes and push them to Joplin. Set to 0 to disable automatic sync (manual button only). Values under 15 are treated as 15.

syncTaskNotes.title: Sync task notes
syncTaskNotes.description: Sync each task's own Notes field (opened from the task itself) with a "Tasks" sub-notebook under the project. Two-way by default — edits in either app get pushed to the other, and if a task's notes changed in both places since the last sync, the more recently edited side wins. Enable "One-way task notes" below to make Super Productivity the only source of truth instead. Separate from the project's Notes tab, which is always synced one-way.

taskNotesOneWay.title: One-way task notes (Super Productivity → Joplin)
taskNotesOneWay.description: Only takes effect when "Sync task notes" is on. Makes task notes one-way, like project notes: edits made directly in Joplin are never pulled back into Super Productivity and get overwritten by Super Productivity's content on the next sync.

archiveRemovedNotes.title: Archive removed notes instead of deleting
archiveRemovedNotes.description: When a note (or task note) no longer exists on the Super Productivity side, move its Joplin note into an "Archive" sub-notebook instead of deleting it outright.
